scene.speaker: erik
scene.bubble: Jungle documentary night! Sofia knows every animal — and I brought popcorn for scientific reasons.

activities.title: Read the sentences and write the jungle animals.

words.clue: It climbs trees and loves bananas.
Long, with no legs. It says sss!
A big orange cat with black stripes.
Long, green, with big teeth. It swims in rivers.
The biggest land animal, with a long nose.
A hot forest full of wild animals.

activities.title: Match the animal with where it hides.
Listen to the documentary. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Sofía (narradora de documental) y Erik (público con palomitas).
data.script: Sofia: Welcome to the jungle, the loudest place on Earth! … Sofia: The monkeys wake up first, at five in the morning. … Erik: Like my little brother! … Sofia: The tiger sleeps sixteen hours and hunts at night. … Sofia: The crocodile can wait in the water for two hours without moving. … Erik: Patience level: maximum. … Sofia: And the elephant family walks ten kilometres every day to find water. … Sofia: The jungle rule: everyone has a place, everyone has a job. … Erik: Beautiful! More popcorn?
